definitions.explanation: A bath for soaking and washing, or the act of taking a bath. In Japan, bathing typically involves washing the body outside the tub before soaking in hot water.

examples.japanese: {風呂|ふろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。

⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧お{風呂|ふろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: Soaking in the bath after work is my greatest pleasure.

notes:
Often said as お{風呂|ふろ}, especially by women and when talking to children; plain {風呂|ふろ} is common in men's casual speech and in compounds such as ⟦{風呂場|ふろば}→風呂場：28822_furoba⟧ (bathroom) and ⟦{風呂上|ふろあ}がり→風呂上がり：22451_furoagari⟧ (just after a bath).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to take a bath
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧: to heat the bath
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沸|わ}く→沸く：01122_waku⟧: the bath is ready
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧: to soak in the bath
- お{風呂|ふろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean the bathtub

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese homes the family shares the same bathwater, so everyone washes and rinses outside the tub before soaking. ⟦{銭湯|せんとう}→銭湯：16032_sentou⟧ (public bathhouse) and ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧ (hot spring) follow the same etiquette.
